checks.evidence: Location accuracy from linking information, steps 1-2: the OBU determines and stores the linking location accuracy (10m) for BG1. The confidence interval reset and the reported distances are not verified.

Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable, step 2: the OBU uses the National Value (20m) when BG2 becomes LRBG/ORBG. The confidence interval reset and the reported distances are not verified.
Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies, step 2: the OBU uses the Default Value (12m) when BG3 becomes LRBG/ORBG. The confidence interval reset is not verified.

invented: Test 1 uses the linking value Q_LOCACC of 10m and test 2 uses the National Value of 20m, both as example values. The requirement does not state them, and neither is written as an assumption.

Test 1 says BG1 contains linking information specifying its own location accuracy. This reads linking as carried by the balise group itself, whereas the requirement and reference use linking information stored on-board.
